_meta.description: Alan Timing Mixing Board — Single source of truth for ALL timing values
_meta.author: Tim (Founder) + Copilot
_meta.warning: Changes here take effect on server restart. Stay within min/max bounds.

voice_pacing._section: How fast Alan speaks and how much he says per turn

tempo_multiplier.description: Audio time-compression. [2026-03-10] Reduced 1.06→1.0 (disabled). Compound speed was making Alan 14-19% faster than natural speech — a major AI tell. Real sales reps on cold calls speak at natural or slightly BELOW natural pace. Authority comes from being unhurried.

tts_default_speed.description: Default TTS speed when no prosody intent overrides. [2026-03-10] Reduced 1.12→1.0 (natural pace). Was making Alan sound 12% faster than any human talks on the phone.

max_sentences.description: Maximum sentences per turn. Was 5→3→2. Metrics: median TTS=3000ms at 3 sentences, target <1500ms. Gong.io: 77% more speaker switches on successful calls = shorter turns win. Phone calls demand brevity — 2 sentences ≈ 3-4s of speech.

question_cap_per_turn.description: Max questions per turn. Prevents double-question pattern. 1 = one question max.

prosody_speed_map._section: Per-intent TTS speed overrides. [2026-03-10] HUMANIZATION PASS: All speeds reduced to natural human range (0.94-1.03). Previous compound speeds (TTS × tempo 1.06) ranged 1.08-1.17 — 8-17% faster than natural speech, a major AI tell. Real cold-call reps speak at or slightly below natural pace. Authority = unhurried. Empathy = slower. Closing = deliberate. Now tempo_multiplier=1.0, so these values ARE the final speed.

turn_timing._section: How long Alan waits for the caller and how fast he responds

turn_timeout.description: How long to wait after caller stops speaking before Alan responds. Was 6.3→3.0→2.5. Tighter for faster perceived response.

llm_parameters._section: LLM generation parameters — controls response length and creativity

relay_max_tokens.description: Max tokens for relay LLM calls. Was 80→60→45→100→80. Metrics: 100 tokens → median 3 sentences → 3000ms TTS. 80 tokens ≈ 2 sentences ≈ 1500ms TTS. Enough for any complete business answer without monologuing.

direct_max_tokens.description: Max tokens for Alan direct LLM calls (fuller responses).

temperature.description: LLM temperature for relay calls. [2026-03-10 CALL-9] Lowered 0.65→0.55. 0.65 was producing too much variation — repetitive/doubled word patterns in output. 0.55 balances variety with consistency. Still above 0.5 for natural variation.

frequency_penalty.description: LLM frequency penalty. [2026-03-10] Raised 0.5→0.7 to push more vocabulary diversity. Forces the LLM to use different words and phrasings turn to turn, reducing the robotic pattern of repeating the same constructions.

call_pacing._section: Call-level timing — ring duration, cooldowns, machine detection

ring_timeout.description: How long to let the phone ring before giving up. 35 = ~7-8 rings. Was 50 (too long, hits voicemail).

campaign_cooldown.description: Campaign cooldown between calls (tools/cooldown_manager). 300 = 5 minutes. [2026-03-02] Was 150 (2.5 min) — doubled to preserve precious leads.

goa._section: [GOA-1.0] Greeting Open Architecture — Segmented interruptible greeting timing. Controls the listen gate between greeting segment 1 (identity) and segment 2 (ask). During the gate, VAD listens for human speech to enable immediate dialogue entry instead of broadcasting a monologue.

listen_gate_duration_s.description: How long to listen for human speech after segment 1 before playing segment 2. Must accommodate echo cooldown (0.3s) + human reaction time (~0.5s) + VAD detection (~0.06s). 1.5s gives ~1.2s of active listening after echo cooldown. Too short = always plays segment 2. Too long = awkward silence.

echo_cooldown_during_gate_s.description: Echo cooldown override during GOA listen gate. Segment 1 is short cached audio (~1.5s) with minimal Twilio buffer tail (~200-400ms). Normal 0.8s cooldown is excessive for this context. 0.3s rejects echo while preserving the gate's listening window.

health_check_interval.description: How often the System Health Guardian runs basic checks.

deep_check_interval.description: How often the Guardian runs deep diagnostics (credential liveness, DB integrity).

breath_patterns._section: Human breath injection timing for natural speech cadence

prosody_silence_frames._section: Inter-sentence silence frames per prosody intent. 1 frame ≈ 20ms. [2026-03-13 CALL-6] REVERTED all tightenings from Call 5 — Call 6 regression: Alan interrupted Tim, lost dialog coherence. Restoring proven values. closing_momentum kept at 8 (Gong: closers pause for weight). objection_handling kept at 13 (empathy needs space).

silence_thresholds._section: Conversation-science silence boundaries. Kendrick 2015: within-speaker gap 520ms, trouble threshold 700ms, standard max 1s. These mark the psychological edges — past trouble_threshold, callers sense something is wrong.

trouble_threshold_ms.description: Silence beyond this feels abnormal to callers (Kendrick 2015). Alan should never exceed this between sentences.

standard_max_silence_ms.description: Absolute max silence before callers disengage. Stivers 2009: 1s = standard maximum gap in English conversation.

conversation_science._section: Research references — NOT used in code, purely for human documentation of why values are what they are.

sources.name: Stivers et al. 2009 (PNAS)
sources.key_findings: Mean gap +208ms, English median 0ms, universals of turn-taking

sources.name: Kendrick 2015 (Frontiers in Psychology)
sources.key_findings: Within-speaker pause 520ms, trouble threshold 700ms, standard max 1s

sources.name: Gong.io Sales Call Analysis
sources.dataset: 2,000,000+ real sales calls analyzed by AI/ML
sources.key_findings: Talk ratio 55:45 on successful cold calls, top reps pause longer after objections, 77% more speaker switches on successful calls, prospect monologue 3.5s successful vs 8s unsuccessful

design_principles: neutral bumped 120ms → 200ms to match Stivers mean gap (+208ms)
objection_handling bumped 180ms → 300ms — Gong: top reps pause ages longer after objections
No silence value should exceed trouble_threshold (700ms) between sentences
empathetic_reflect at 280ms — near Stivers mean, gives emotional breath space
